# Changelog — GRPC Spec

Tracks version history for `requirements.md`, `design.md`, and `tasks.md` in this folder. All
three files share one changelog since they change together as one spec unit. Newest version first.

## v1.0 (initial)

- Initial spec for `InnerLamp/Core/GRPC/`, written **before** any code exists — fully
  **prospective**. Generated by `il-spec-writer` directly from `Docs/Specs/GRPC/SRS.md` (`il-ba`'s
  IEEE 29148 SRS, dated 2026-09-28), which is the authoritative source for every requirement and
  every open question below.
- `requirements.md`: user story + EARS acceptance criteria across six areas — channel/TLS, auth
  metadata, RPC call shapes (unary + server-streaming), error handling, configuration,
  observability, build/codegen, and testing. Carries forward all six unresolved ⚠️ markers from
  SRS Appendix A verbatim (no `.proto` contract yet; unconfirmed host/port values; unverified
  `grpc-swift v2` minimum OS/Swift version; no identified first streaming consumer; unconfirmed
  keepalive-ping need; unpinned package version/tag) plus the SRS's 13 already-resolved open
  questions, moved to "Open questions (resolved)".
- `design.md`: layers table for the seven new/modified components (`GRPCConfiguration`,
  `GRPCAuthInterceptor`, `GRPCError`, `GRPCLogger`, the unary/streaming client entry point,
  `APIConfig`'s gRPC extension, the codegen plugin, the in-process test server) mirroring
  `Docs/Specs/Networking/design.md`'s shape; two Step-by-step Flow sections (unary and
  server-streaming, since each involves multiple internal steps with distinct failure branches,
  per `references/step_by_step_flow.md`'s mandate); a `GRPCError` case-mapping table; an
  "Architecture note" cross-referencing `Docs/Specs/Networking/design.md`'s own anticipation of
  this migration and naming exactly which REST primitives do and don't carry over.
- `design.md`: flags two additional implementation-time ⚠️s beyond the SRS's own list — the exact
  file/type naming for the client entry point and codegen plugin target (placeholders, not
  confirmed), and whether streaming logs per-message, per-stream, or both (the SRS's `FR-010`
  doesn't pick one).
- `tasks.md`: 9 phases (0 through 8), ordered so Phase 0 (dependency/environment groundwork) and
  Phase 1 (channel/TLS) unblock everything else, mirroring `Docs/Specs/Networking/tasks.md`'s
  "unblocking phase first" rationale. Every box starts `[ ]` — nothing is implemented. Each ⚠️ from
  `requirements.md`/`design.md` is attached to the specific phase/task it blocks, not just listed
  once at the top.
- Scope note recorded in all three files: this is an **infrastructure** spec under `Core/`, not a
  feature-scene spec — no Coordinator, no ViewModel, no navigation flow. `il-screen-builder` does
  not apply. `il-data-layer-builder`'s consuming-side work cannot start until a `.proto` contract
  exists (Pending).
- Reason for writing it: `il-ba`'s SRS (`Docs/Specs/GRPC/SRS.md`) was confirmed as ready for
  downstream handoff per its own header ("Downstream handoff: `il-spec-writer` →
  `requirements.md` / `design.md` / `tasks.md`"); this version turns that SRS into the three-file
  spec convention without resolving any of its open ⚠️ markers on its own authority.
